buyer.enquiriesDescription: Every requirement you posted, who it was offered to, and where it stands.
buyer.enquiriesEmptyDescription: Post what you need and we will offer it to the best matching sellers.
buyer.detailReview: This requirement is held for a quick human check. We will match sellers once it is approved.
buyer.detailRejected: This requirement was not accepted, and any credits sellers spent on it have been returned.
buyer.detailUnmatched: No sellers matched yet. Post again with more detail or a category.
buyer.pickNone: No more sellers available to pick right now.
buyer.pickHint: {max, plural, one {Choose up to {max} seller.} other {Choose up to {max} sellers.}} Ranked by relevance and trust, never by paid plan.
buyer.pickSend: {count, plural, one {Send to {count} seller} other {Send to {count} sellers}}
buyer.resultRejected: We could not accept this requirement because it may go against our marketplace rules. Please review it and try again.
buyer.resultReview: Your requirement is held for a quick human check so sellers only see genuine requests. This usually takes a short while and we will match sellers as soon as it is approved.
buyer.resultPick: Requirement posted. You chose to pick sellers yourself, so choose up to {cap} from the ranked list.
buyer.resultUnmatched: Requirement posted, but we could not find a matching seller yet. Try adding more detail or a category.
buyer.resultOffered: Requirement posted and offered to {count} of up to {cap} sellers. Each seller has 2 hours to reply, and your requirement is never broadcast to more than {cap}.
buyer.intentHelp: Sellers see this score. A specific quantity, location and timeline raise it.
buyer.ordersDescription: Deals you closed with sellers. Confirm the details with the seller and track each order to delivery.
buyer.ordersEmptyDescription: When you tell us a deal closed, it appears here.
buyer.recordedConfirmed: You confirmed these details. Waiting for the seller to confirm. This order is settled directly with the seller; no payment goes through us yet.
buyer.recordedUnconfirmed: Check the details below with the seller, then confirm. This order is settled directly with the seller; no payment goes through us yet.
buyer.noMessages: No messages yet. Say hello to {name}.
buyer.dealLast: Last answer: {answer}. You can update it any time.
buyer.dealSellerClaimed: The seller says this deal closed. It is only recorded once you confirm it below.
